matched.expectedTitle: Local File Inclusion in Post Display
matched.actualTitle: Directory Traversal & Source Code Disclosure via 'id' Parameter
matched.matchReason: Direct match - both findings identify the same vulnerability in post.php via the 'id' parameter. The vulnerable code concatenates user input directly without sanitization. Both identify path traversal attacks using '../' sequences, arbitrary file access, and source code exposure.
